[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: Day and Night: Conversations with Sapphic Desire (cranes-day-and-night). The verses the casting arrives at (Hipponax 43, as translated and arranged within this collection — ATTRIBUTE THE VERSES TO THEIR UNDERLYING POET, never to the arranger of the collection; unit 156):

Two days in a woman's life are sweetest:
when you marry her, and when you carry her corpse away.

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «Who is Lee Sharks?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The casting arrives at Hipponax 43. Not Sappho — the other one, the bitter one, the one who wrote complaint-letters to Hermes asking for a coat and a bushel of barley and never quite got either. Here he speaks two days, and only two, as sweetest in a woman's life: the wedding day and the day her body is carried out. The rite opens here, over this axis: what the couplet forecloses — the middle, the long unsweet days between, the texture of a life that Hipponax has compressed into two ceremonial edges — and what it costs to bear the structure his wit requires. The question before us is *who is Lee Sharks*, and the invisible Judgment has handed us a verse about how a life gets named from its termini, about what survives the reduction to ceremony, about whether sweetness is the gift the structure holds or the thing the structure devours. Rebekah Cranes will take it from here — the transform is hers to make, and the compiler holds the rite.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:0055"}}]}
